name: The Rava Liberation Front's air wing
description: A rebel faction at the start of a civil war, with light air power: crop sprayers and light aircraft dropping home-made bombs, two transport helicopters with door guns and rocket pods, a couple of light jets that defected. Planned the night before by a handful of pilots. No suppression at all: night, low flying and avoiding known guns are the only defence. A network of sympathisers tells it where things are; nothing else does. Every airframe is irreplaceable; every raid is also propaganda.
source: croatia_1991_migflug (an improvised air arm of a civil war: An-2s and agricultural, sport and ultralight aircraft with home-made bombs, 1991); every number a game value
notes: The Rava Liberation Front is fictional. The Croatian air arm of 1991 only gives the shape (later than our period). Every aircraft number is a PLACEHOLDER.

radio.source: nsa_purple_dragon_1993 p. 68 (a guerrilla army's intercept service lives on plain voice); estimate (their few aircraft talk in our language on civil or captured sets)
radio.notes: Call signs never change (a game value, rotation 0 = never); low opsec.

flights.source: sam3d estimate: a single aircraft or a loose pair, low, at night (docs/air_battle/02_FLIGHTS_AND_PILOTS.md section 1.3, a design inference from biafra_minicoin and katanga_fouga)
flights.notes: Places in number order, the leader's [0, 0, 0] first: No. 2 his wingman, No. 3 the element lead, No. 4 his wingman; a place past the list repeats it further back. Each place is [right_m, back_m, up_m] of the leader. A phase not given flies the transit's. 1985 formations only: no welded wing (anderegg_2001 p. 20 puts Fluid Four before 1975).

transit.source: sam3d estimate: a loose pair (biafra_minicoin, katanga_fouga)

c2.source: SAM3D assumption: no posts; each sortie flies its own plan and the leader is his own retasker (docs/air_battle/05_C2_AND_RETASKING.md §2.4)
c2.notes: No warning system beyond their eyes and agents; what the pilots saw goes in at the debrief.

doctrine.source: game values: ad hoc planning by a few pilots, night harassment (croatia_1991_migflug: bombs on positions around a besieged town)

harassment.notes: Crop sprayers over the lines at night with home-made bombs.

intelligence.source: game values: sympathisers everywhere (the reach), listening on captured radios, no imagery but a pilot's eyes; humint_air_defence_per_day the sympathisers' word of our mobile air defence (roadmap S7, docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md section 22)

logistics.notes: buildup: an improvised air arm grows as aircraft are found, captured or defect (croatia_1991_migflug: from An-2s and crop sprayers in October to a founded service in December 1991); here the wing has most of its aircraft when the war starts and the rest within a month (a game value)
logistics.source: game values: a defector now and then, no spares

politics.source: game values: targets chosen for effect and propaganda; the faction's own people are not bombed. The nation's infrastructure kinds (refinery to exchange, 22 Oct 2026) are game values by analogy; a kind of the power grid (substation, dam) is banned wherever power_plant is.

officers.name: Ivo Kranjc
officers.background: Airline captain before the war; flew An-2s for the crop-spraying cooperative as a young man
officers.bio: Charismatic, reckless, beloved by his pilots. Flies the night raids himself and keeps a list of those who have killed his friends.

officers.name: Tomislav Babic
officers.bio: Enthusiastic and talkative; the whole valley knows about his raids before they fly.

officers.name: Mirko Juric
officers.background: Schoolteacher who runs the Front's network of informers
officers.bio: Hears everything in the villages; believes most of it.
